prompt: Which Marvel superhero is Peter Parker?
rationale: Peter Parker is Spider-Man. Stark's Iron Man,Murdock's Daredevil,Barton's Hawkeye wrong. Comics identity differs from prior question about radioactive origin. Publisher Spider-Man biography inspected through index.

prompt: Which Marvel superhero is Steve Rogers best known as?
rationale: Steve Rogers is Captain America, not Strange,Ant-Man,Panther. Familiar identity, not claim only Rogers ever carries title. Publisher multiverse guide explicitly identifies original Steve Rogers.

prompt: Which Marvel superhero uses the civilian name Matt Murdock?
rationale: Matt Murdock is Daredevil. Iron Fist,Luke Cage,Moon Knight different people. Publisher Daredevil Legacy names blind lawyer; distinct from existing hair-colour and nickname questions.

prompt: Which scientist was Marvel's original Ant-Man?
rationale: Hank Pym original Ant-Man; Banner Hulk,Richards Mister Fantastic,Stark Iron Man. Original qualifier needed because Scott Lang also Ant-Man. Avengers history explicitly pairs Hank Pym/Ant-Man.

prompt: Which Marvel archer is Clint Barton?
rationale: Clint Barton is Hawkeye. Falcon,Vision,Quicksilver other heroes. Publisher reveal names archer; no claim Kate Bishop cannot also use title.

prompt: Natasha Romanoff is best known by which superhero name?
rationale: Natasha Romanoff is Black Widow, not Wanda's Scarlet Witch,Janet's Wasp,Sue's Invisible Woman. Actual Comics biography uses Romanova/Romanoff variants; supplied familiar form is valid.

prompt: Under which superhero name was Sam Wilson best known before becoming Captain America?
rationale: Sam Wilson originally Falcon before Captain America; others unrelated identities. Publisher Captain Americas guide explicitly former Falcon. Does not imply Wilson never returns to Falcon identity later.

prompt: Bucky Barnes is associated with which identity after his time as Captain America's wartime partner?
rationale: Bucky Barnes later Winter Soldier. Surfer,Strange,Rider other characters. Namor comics biography explicitly Bucky later Winter Soldier; no claim this was his only later identity, since he also became Captain America.

prompt: Which Marvel vigilante is Frank Castle?
rationale: Frank Castle is Punisher. Murdock,Spector,Rand other offered vigilantes. Publisher Nick Fury biography identifies Frank Castle AKA Punisher; term vigilante avoids debating superhero vs antihero.

prompt: Which of these names is one of Moon Knight's identities?
rationale: Marc Spector one Moon Knight identity. Matt,Clint,Reed not his other identities. One of qualifier respects Steven Grant/Jake Lockley rather than falsely reducing dissociative identity to one alias.

prompt: Besides his claws, Wolverine is especially known for which ability?
rationale: Wolverine healing factor supports rapid recovery. Underwater breathing,sand transformation,weather control not signature abilities. Publisher adamantium account and character sheet healing factor checked; not invulnerability to every injury.

prompt: Magneto's powers especially involve controlling what?
rationale: Magneto magnetic powers/metal. Dreams,fire,tides not principal power. X-Men official history explicitly mastery of magnetism; does not assert only ferromagnetic real-world physics applies in fiction.

prompt: Which X-Men founder is especially known for telepathy?
rationale: Professor X telepathic founder. Cyclops optic blasts,Colossus metal,Iceman ice do not provide this answer. X-Men official history identifies Xavier's telepathy/founding role.

prompt: What is Mystique's signature ability in Marvel Comics?
rationale: Mystique shapeshifts appearance, not ice,earthquakes,fire. Publisher biography explicitly shape-shifting mutant. No appearance-only limit asserted on every continuity or current expanded powers.

prompt: What is Nightcrawler especially known for doing?
rationale: Nightcrawler teleportation, not Storm's weather control,growinggiant,archery. Publisher X-Men character sheet explicitly Teleport; classic ability rather than invented maximum distance.

prompt: Colossus can transform his body into a form resembling what?
rationale: Colossus metal form, not glass,sand,wood. Publisher Colossus introduction explicitly describes steel; metal keeps accessible and avoids overtechnical organic-steel mechanism.

prompt: The X-Man Bobby Drake is best known by which superhero name?
rationale: Bobby Drake Iceman, not Scott's Cyclops,Hank's Beast,Remy's Gambit. Publisher Iceman biography explicitly names Bobby. Different from a general superhero ice-power prompt.

prompt: What are Gambit's most famous energy-charged throwing weapons?
rationale: Gambit charges playing cards;chess pieces,tennis balls,paper money not iconic thrown objects. Publisher X-Men character sheet charged cards checked. Famously allows his power to charge other objects too.

prompt: What size-changing ability gives Ant-Man his name?
rationale: Ant-Man shrinks. Intangibility,invisibility,mind-reading are other powers, replacing always-growing and bizarre flat-picture options. Official Disney/Marvel activity account explicitly describes Lang shrinking; not claim he cannot grow too.

prompt: Janet van Dyne is best known by which superhero name?
rationale: Janet van Dyne Wasp. Storm,Natasha's Widow,Carol's Captain Marvel wrong. Publisher oral history explicitly Janet AKA Wasp; no universal claim no other Wasps exist.

prompt: What gives Steve Rogers his enhanced abilities in Captain America's classic comic-book origin?
rationale: Shield-star detail replaced with text-verified origin: super-soldier treatment. Spider bite,cosmic rays,symbiote other Marvel mechanisms. Captain Americas publisher guide explicitly Steve recipient of serum. Avoid treating uninspected cover artwork as reviewed visual evidence.

prompt: What weapon is Hawkeye most closely associated with?
rationale: Hawkeye bow/arrows;trident,hammer,sword not signature archery equipment. Publisher reveal quiver/arrows and official RPG Hawkeye arrow discussion support. Most closely associated allows occasional use of other weapons.

prompt: What does Spider-Man's spider-sense chiefly warn him about?
answers: The precise distance to every object in space
rationale: Spider-sense warns impending danger. Not general mind-reading,lie detection or exact universal-distance measurement. Publisher biography explicit; replace stock-market/food-freshness joke options with distinguishable powers.

prompt: Which rare metal is especially associated with Wakanda in Marvel Comics?
rationale: Wakanda vibranium, not Wolverine's adamantium,Asgardian uru,DC promethium. Publisher Panther villains account explicitly stolen precious vibranium in Wakanda. No claim found nowhere else in every later continuity.

prompt: Which sense did Matt Murdock lose in the accident in Daredevil's origin?
rationale: Murdock loses sight, retains enhanced other senses. Hearing,smell,touch not lost in origin. Publisher Daredevil first-issue description explicitly blinded; not a real-world medical claim about radiation.

prompt: What colour is Bruce Banner's Hulk form most commonly depicted as?
rationale: Banner Hulk most commonly green. Blue,pink,purple wrong for familiar form. Most commonly necessary because original grey Hulk and other incarnations exist. Publisher sheet explicitly green; no false always-green claim.

prompt: Which Fantastic Four heroine is especially known for becoming invisible?
rationale: Sue Storm Invisible Woman. Jean,Natasha,Ororo other heroines. Publisher powers guide checked; no claim invisibility is her only ability, since force fields also central.

prompt: Johnny Storm's powers allow him to cover his body in what?
rationale: Johnny's body aflame, not ice,stone,sand. Official Human Torch flame-form profile. Human Torch name given but question asks power, not a physics assertion human skin can safely burn.

prompt: The Thing's familiar orange skin resembles what material?
rationale: Thing rock-like skin, not glass,wood,water. Fantastic Four publisher history explicitly rock-like body. Resembles avoids uncertain literal geological composition.

prompt: Which Marvel superhero is Stephen Strange?
rationale: Cloak flight claim replaced with straightforward identity: Stephen Strange is Doctor Strange. Hawkeye,Iron Man,Cap different people. Publisher Avengers roster explicitly pairs identity; distinct from existing former-surgeon question.

prompt: Which character is a longstanding ally of Doctor Strange in Marvel Comics?
rationale: Wong longstanding Strange ally. Alfred,Gordon DC;Jameson Spider-Man editor. Official Wong comics history describes joint adventures. No servant-only stereotype or current office assumed.

prompt: Peter Quill uses which superhero name?
rationale: Peter Quill Star-Lord. Surfer,Nova,Moon Knight different identities. Publisher character comics listing explicitly pairs name. Hyphen in Star-Lord correct.

prompt: What kind of being is Groot in Marvel Comics?
rationale: Groot tree-like alien/Flora colossus, not human,robot,undersea king. Publisher character sheet explicitly PlanetX plant-being/regrowth. Avoid claiming ordinary Earth tree.

prompt: Rocket of the Guardians of the Galaxy resembles which animal?
rationale: Rocket resembles raccoon, not fox,otter,badger. Publisher Rocket Raccoon character sheet. Resembles avoids conflating engineered extraterrestrial origin with ordinary terrestrial animal.

prompt: Gamora is best known as a member of which Marvel superhero team?
rationale: Adoptive-daughter prompt changed to readily verifiable team membership: Gamora best known as Guardian. FF,X-Men,New Mutants wrong core association. Official top-ten Guardians explicitly lists her; no claim exclusive membership in every story.

prompt: Which title is closely associated with the Guardians character Drax?
rationale: Drax the Destroyer, not Strange's Sorcerer Supreme,Daredevil's Man Without Fear,Aquaman's king title. Publisher Drax issue description explicitly Destroyer. No MCU literal-idiom personality generalisation.

prompt: Which Avenger is an android with a synthetic body?
rationale: Vision android/syntheticbody, other offered heroes human. Publisher Avengers history explicitly creation of android Vision. No claim every subsequent reconstructed body identical.

prompt: What is Quicksilver's best-known superpower?
rationale: Quicksilver super speed, not plants,metalbody,underwater breathing. Publisher Young Avengers compares Speed's powers to Pietro. Best-known qualifier accommodates unusual temporary powers.

prompt: Quicksilver and Scarlet Witch are related in what way?
rationale: Pietro/Wanda twins, not fatherdaughter/uncleniece/married. Publisher Quicksilver fast facts explicitly Wanda's twin. Avoid disputed/retconned parentage entirely.

prompt: Which Marvel cosmic hero travels on a silvery board?
rationale: Silver Surfer cosmic surfboard, not Nova,Quill,Warlock's characteristic transport. Publisher Silver Surfer issue describes Dawn joining his board to explore universe and facsimile specifically his board. No numeric speed claim.

prompt: Which Marvel character is famously known as the Devourer of Worlds?
rationale: Galactus Devourer of Worlds, not Doom,Kingpin,Goblin. Replace diet question with silly only-books/sandwiches alternatives. Official Galactus/world-devouring publisher account supports title; no physical cosmology claim.

prompt: Doctor Doom rules which fictional country in Marvel Comics?
rationale: Doom Latveria, not Wakanda,Genosha,Sokovia. Publisher Doom2025 issue places his rule behind Latverian borders; classic fictional-country association not claim he never rules other territories.

prompt: In Marvel's Thor stories, Loki is Thor's what?
rationale: Loki adopted brother, not biological father,son,grandfather. Publisher Loki comics history explicit adopted sibling; scope Marvel Thor, not inconsistent real-world myth genealogy.

prompt: Who is the original Green Goblin in the Spider-Man comics?
rationale: Norman Osborn original Green Goblin. Octavius DocOck,Fisk Kingpin,Connors Lizard. Original qualifier avoids Harry/other later Goblins. Publisher Goblin reading guide and history checked.

prompt: Doctor Octopus is especially known for having what mechanical equipment?
answers: A pair of powered mechanical wings
rationale: Doctor Octopus four mechanical tentacles;wing harness,wheel,robotspider other gear. Publisher bio explicitly four mechanical tentacle-like arms. Distinguish mechanical count from his four natural limbs; better alternatives replace joke glove option.

prompt: What is the civilian name of the Marvel crime boss Kingpin?
rationale: Kingpin Wilson Fisk, not Osborn,Doom,Brock. Publisher Kingpin profile explicitly identity. Question not nickname-of-every-crime-boss terminology.

prompt: Which of these characters is famously a host of the Venom symbiote?
rationale: Eddie Brock famous Venom host. Alfred,Gordon,Clark different DC characters. Publisher Venom reading guide explicitly Eddie bond; not first living thing or only host, since Peter and others also hosted symbiote.

prompt: The stunt rider Johnny Blaze is associated with which Marvel identity?
rationale: Johnny Blaze Ghost Rider, not MoonKnight,IronFist,Daredevil. Publisher Spirits of Vengeance history calls him motorcycle stunt rider and Rider. Multiple Ghost Riders permitted, no unique-only claim.

prompt: Luke Cage is especially known for super strength and what other physical feature?
rationale: Cage strength and tough skin. Elasticlimbs,claws,electric skin other abilities. Publisher reading guide explicit strength/unbreakable skin; bullet-resistant rather than absolute immunity keeps reasonable fictional qualification.

prompt: Which Marvel martial artist is Danny Rand?
rationale: Danny Rand Iron Fist. Luke,Murdock,Castle different martial/street heroes. Publisher IronFist1975 issue explicitly Danny AKA Iron Fist. No claim Rand only historical bearer.

prompt: Which billionaire is Batman's best-known civilian identity?
rationale: Bruce Wayne Batman, not Kent,Queen,Luthor. DC biography and history explicit. Best-known qualifier accommodates other Batmen/continuities.

prompt: What is Batman's famous customised car called?
rationale: Batmobile car;InvisibleJet aircraft,Quinjet aircraft,SpiderMobile another hero. DC history explicitly customised Batmobile. Not falsely named every vehicle used by Batman.

prompt: A batarang is Batman's version of which kind of weapon?
answers: A laser cannon worn on the wrist
rationale: Batarang bat-shaped thrown weapon, not torpedo,wristlaser,sword. DC Batman biography identifies utility-belt Batarangs; distinct from ordinary biological bat. No claim every version returns like a real boomerang.

prompt: Which fictional mineral is Superman famously vulnerable to?
rationale: Kryptonite famous vulnerability, not quartz/granite/diamond. Official DC kryptonite discussion inspected. No colour-specific claim that could confuse green/gold/red variants or other weaknesses such as magic.

prompt: Superman can produce intense heat beams from which part of his body?
rationale: Heat vision from eyes;ears,knees,feet wrong. DC heat-vision history explicit eye-based visual power. No false claim actual x-rays work this way.

prompt: Kara Zor-El is best known as which DC superhero?
rationale: Kara Zor-El Supergirl, not WonderWoman,Batgirl,Canary. DC Supergirl comics description explicitly names Kara. Proper spelling excludes Kara Zor-L/Power Girl of another Earth.

prompt: In the usual DC Comics continuity, Kara Zor-El is Superman's what?
rationale: Kara usual Superman cousin, not mother/daughter/grandmother. DC Girl of Steel collection explicit cousin. Usual continuity avoids unrelated Supergirl versions and different origin timelines.

prompt: What is Wonder Woman's famous truth-compelling rope called?
rationale: Lasso of Truth correct;GoldenWeb,RopeDreams,SilverSnare wrong. DC defining WonderWoman moments explicitly iconic Lasso of Truth. Traditional name, not claim she cannot own other ropes/artifacts.

prompt: Barry Allen is best known as which DC superhero?
rationale: Barry Allen Flash, not Lantern,Arrow,Aquaman. DC Flash biography explicitly Jay,Barry,Wally as title bearers. No only-Flash or first-Flash assertion.

prompt: Which Batman villain is Pamela Isley?
rationale: Pamela Isley Poison Ivy. Harleen,Selina,Talia other characters. DC PoisonIvyThorns publisher description explicitly Pamela. No assertion current stories always define her purely villain rather than antihero.

rationale: Former Robin JasonTodd RedHood;Dick Nightwing,Tim/ Damian otherRobins. DC RedHood biography explicit. Best-known avoids claiming nobody else ever wore RedHood identity, including Joker predecessor.

prompt: Barbara Gordon is closely associated with which costumed identity?

prompt: What is Robin's usual role alongside Batman?
rationale: Robin usually Batman crime-fighting partner, not father,Metropolis mayor,editor. DC Batman history original sidekick. Not claim every Robin biologically related or always a child.

prompt: Which DC superhero identity is associated with Jaime Reyes?
rationale: Jaime Reyes BlueBeetle, not BoosterGold,Atom,PlasticMan. DC biography explicitly thirdBlueBeetle. No mistake calling Jaime first, given Garrett/Kord predecessors.

prompt: Plastic Man's signature power allows him to do what?
rationale: PlasticMan stretches/reshapes, not weather/sea-onlyspeech/iceproduction. DC biography and original archive collection explicit. Does not reduce all his transformations to one body size.

prompt: Superman, Batman and Wonder Woman are closely associated with which superhero team?
rationale: Trinity closely associated JusticeLeague. FF,XMen,Guardians Marvel groups. Official DC League introduction names Superman,Batman,WonderWoman. Not an assertion every era has identical founders or membership.

He is secretly a Roman god

prompt: What is the English name of Obelix's small dog?

prompt: Which druid brews the magic potion in the English-language Asterix books?

prompt: What is Cacofonix's role in Asterix's village?
rationale: Cacofonix bard, not blacksmith,fishmonger,chief. Official bio calls bard and schoolteacher; question does not deny his second role. No qualitative opinion that music bad posed as fact.

prompt: Who is the chief of Asterix's village in the English-language books?
rationale: Vitalstatistix chief, not other named villagers. Official character bio explicitly chief. English-language names and spelling checked.

prompt: Which Beano character is known as Minnie the what?

answers: A book-length story told through sequential artwork and text
A prose novel with no illustrations
A book made entirely of screenplay instructions
rationale: Graphic novel book-length sequentialart/textstory, not prose-only,script-only,audio. Cambridge explicit longstorymostlypictures with writing. No false requirement all graphic novels fiction or originally one volume.

answers: A sequence of drawings telling a story
A single scene performed on stage
rationale: Comicstrip sequentialdrawingsstory, not proseeditorial,stage scene,audiodrama. Cambridge definition checked, but don't require all strips funny despite introductory wording. Replace unrelated pricing/index alternatives with actual narrative formats.

The colours added to the artwork
The physical binding of the book

rationale: BANG/SPLASH imitate sounds, so onomatopoeia;anagram,palindrome,acronym do not define these examples. Actual Cambridge sound-imitation definition. Original prompt remains clear with both examples ordinary English soundwords.
